mechanism: Tenofovir can cause renal dysfunction and electrolyte abnormalities, which may increase perphenazine levels and enhance antipsychotic effects; perphenazine also carries orthostatic and CNS risks that may be compounded in renally compromised patients.
action: Monitor renal function regularly, assess for signs of perphenazine toxicity (extrapyramidal symptoms, orthostasis), and consider dose adjustment if renal impairment develops.
